title: Concept: renv lockfile records a cleartext package source
description: renv.lock declares a package whose recorded source is a cleartext http location, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: `renv::restore()` fetches over http, so the package bytes cross the network unencrypted.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through renv.lock (cran).
risk: `renv::restore()` fetches over http, so the package bytes cross the network unencrypted.
